title: Two Famous Inventors
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous American inventor. He made a light bulb that worked for a long time. Edison worked in a large laboratory with many assistants. He tested thousands of materials before he found a good one.

Alexander Graham Bell is famous for the telephone. He was interested in how people hear and speak. Bell worked hard for many years on his idea. Today, many people use a telephone every day because of his work.

questions.text: What did Edison do in his laboratory?
Why did Edison test so many materials?
options: He wanted to find a good material for the light bulb
He did not like his laboratory

questions.text: What can you infer about Bell from the passage?
options: He worked hard on his ideas
He stopped working after one year

vocabulary.definition: a room where scientists do experiments
a device used to talk to people who are far away

paragraph_translations: Thomas Edison foi um famoso inventor americano. Ele criou uma lâmpada que funcionava por muito tempo. Edison trabalhava em um grande laboratório com muitos assistentes. Ele testou milhares de materiais antes de encontrar um bom.

Alexander Graham Bell é famoso pelo telefone. Ele se interessava por como as pessoas ouvem e falam. Bell trabalhou duro por muitos anos em sua ideia. Hoje, muitas pessoas usam o telefone todos os dias por causa do seu trabalho.
